# p10k-rs v0.2.4

**The "revert Windows + docs catch-up" release.** v0.2.3 added
Windows MSVC targets to the release matrix; both failed at cargo
build time because `p10k-rs-core` uses `rustix::termios` /
`std::os::fd::AsFd` / `rustix::process::geteuid` unconditionally
across eight+ files. The CI matrix entry was the easy half — the
Unix-only API audit and Windows fallbacks (Console API for raw
mode, `whoami` for identity, ShellOut-only since FIFO IPC has no
Windows equivalent) are the hard half. v0.2.4 reverts the matrix
entry and ships the docs catch-up that was already on `main`.

## What changed

### Removed

- Windows MSVC entries from `.github/workflows/release.yml`.
  Restoring them is a one-line matrix edit once the portability
  work lands; the per-OS packaging branches stay in place inert.

### Added (the docs catch-up)

- Six segment pages closing v0.2.3's dead "see also" links:
  `vcs`, `virtualenv`, `pyenv`, `nodenv`, `pixi`, `root_indicator`.
- Top-level `troubleshooting.md` page that opens with
  `p10k-rs doctor` and covers the common fresh-install snags.

## What's the same

- All v0.2.3 features ship — `p10k-rs doctor [--json]`, the 14
  v0.2.3 segment pages, gate-restore fixes. v0.2.3 was a tag
  failure but the unix artifacts on the v0.2.3 release page are
  intact; v0.2.4 supersedes it cleanly.
- Test count, schema, architecture invariants unchanged.
- Toolchain: Rust 1.88.

## Windows port — what would be needed

Tracked in the comment block on the now-removed matrix entry. The
short version:

| Module | What's Unix-only | Windows fallback shape |
|---|---|---|
| `p10k-rs-core::term_caps` / `term_query` | `rustix::termios`, `std::os::fd::AsFd` | Console API raw mode + `HANDLE`-based polling, or `cfg(unix)` + Windows skip |
| `p10k-rs-core::safety::open_owned_safely` | `O_NOFOLLOW`, `fstat` uid check | Windows ACL probe + reparse-point reject, or `cfg(unix)` + reduced safety |
| `p10k-rs-core::terminal_width` | `rustix::termios::tcgetwinsize` | `GetConsoleScreenBufferInfo` |
| `p10k-rs-segments::context` / `root_indicator` | `rustix::process::geteuid`, `system::uname` | `whoami` crate or `cfg(unix)` skip |
| `p10k-rs-segments::dir` | `rustix::fs::access(W_OK)` | `metadata().permissions().readonly()` |
| `p10k-rs-git::gitstatusd` | FIFO IPC, `O_NOFOLLOW` | Skip daemon entirely; ShellOut backend only |
| Install script | bash | PowerShell installer or Scoop |

Each row is a small slice. The whole pile is its own milestone.
